description: Dataset for Fault Detection and Isolation of Photovoltaic System Using LSTM Neural Network is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Elaf R.Kadhim, Amin Mihankhah (Electrical Engineering Department, University of Qom, Qom, Iran). This dataset contains Excel data files used in the research paper titled “LSTM-based fault detection and isolation of photovoltaic system under electrical faults and partial shading using noisy dataset.” It includes normal case data, fault scenarios (partial shading, open-circuit, short-circuit) used to train and evaluate the LSTM model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
